Imbalances · Intermediate

Consequent Encroachment (CE)

The 50% midpoint of an FVG. Some practitioners treat touch of this midpoint as partial mitigation or entry reference.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Measure exact FVG boundaries.
  2. Calculate 50% midpoint.
  3. Record whether plan requires touch, close or rejection.
Use as a precise reference within a pre-defined FVG.

Common mistakes and limitations

CE touch is not proof of support/resistance or automatic fill.
